name: toolium-resource-navigator
description: Navigate Toolium resource placeholders and autocomplete LANG/CONF keys.

editor/context.when: editorLangId == python || editorLangId == gherkin || editorLangId == feature || resourceExtname == .feature

tooliumResources.configurationPaths.description: Workspace-relative directories containing CONF JSON resources.

tooliumResources.baseConfigurationFiles.description: Base configuration filenames, shown before environment definitions. Private files are always excluded.

tooliumResources.poeditorPaths.description: Workspace-relative directories containing POEditor JSON arrays.

tooliumResources.tooliumPaths.description: Workspace-relative directories containing toolium.cfg and local-toolium.cfg. Only these two filenames are searched, without recursion.

tooliumResources.filePath.description: Workspace-relative base directory for FILE and FILE_UTF8 references.

tooliumResources.base64Path.description: Workspace-relative base directory for BASE64 references.

tooliumResources.poeditorSearchType.description: POEditor key matching mode. Toolium defaults to contains; this extension keeps exact for compatibility.

tooliumResources.poeditorKeyField.description: POEditor object field containing lookup identifiers.

tooliumResources.poeditorPrefixes.description: POEditor prefixes tried in order before the unprefixed identifier. The first matching prefix across all files wins.

tooliumResources.enableUsageNavigation.description: Enable Go to Definition (Cmd/Ctrl+click) from LANG/CONF keys, POE identifiers and TOOLIUM sections/options to their usages. Find All References remains available.

tooliumResources.referencePaths.description: Workspace-relative directories searched recursively for literal LANG, CONF, POE and TOOLIUM usages in Python and feature files. An empty list disables searching.
